name: carbon-carbon
instr:
I'm restoring the date/time arithmetic and reporting side of our copy of carbon (`github.com/dromara/carbon/v2`). We use it for scheduling and "how long ago" displays, and a lot of that code currently panics with "not implemented".

The stubs are spread over the root package: `traveler.go` (the Add/Sub families, including the NoOverflow variants, plus `Tomorrow`/`Yesterday`), `difference.go` (the Diff and DiffAbs functions and `DiffForHumans`), `boundary.go`, `comparer.go`, `extremum.go`, `parser.go` (`ParseByFormat`, `ParseByFormats`), `setter.go`, `outputer.go`, `season.go`, `constellation.go`, `getter.go`, `language.go`, `type_format.go`, and a few helpers in `carbon.go` and `errors.go`. Could you implement all of them?

The doc comments on those functions are the contract, so please follow them exactly. Small details such as output text matter because other code compares against them.

Please keep every exported name and signature as it is; private helpers are up to you. I'll run the package's own tests, and the rest of the module's tests must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:embed` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build
